settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subtitle: Answers to common developer questions about schema extraction, theme shadowing, and performance.

settings.question: How does the inline @schema() directive work?
settings.answer: @schema() is extracted directly from your Blade view files by SchemaExtractor during scanner registration. It registers immutable SectionSchema and BlockSchema value objects without running or rendering the view.

settings.question: Do I need database migrations for page layouts?
settings.answer: No! Pages and templates are backed by clean JSON documents stored on disk in your resources directory. You can track layouts directly in Git version control.

settings.question: How does theme shadowing work?
settings.answer: When a theme is active, any Blade file located in your theme views directory automatically shadows built-in package sections and blocks. Last registration always wins.

settings.question: What setting types are supported in @schema()?
settings.answer: Supported types include text, textarea, richtext (TipTap), select, radio, checkbox, number, range slider, color, image_picker, alignment, icon_picker, and url.

settings.question: What is the performance overhead of rendering pages?
settings.answer: Hydrated section and block models render directly into native Blade views with sub-millisecond execution times (<0.2ms) and zero extra database queries.
